text_block_list.text:
Christmas. Parties were being held all 
over the academy, and lively laughter 
echoed all around.
choice_data_list:
(Everyone looks like they're having so 
much fun, and here I am—)

(Everyone looks like they're having so 
much fun, and here I am—)

text_block_list.text:
I had no plans to attend the party. So, as 
I was heading back to the Trainer Dorms...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —Yo, Trainie. Looked all over for ya.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Are you free today? It's Christmas, wanna 
hang out?

"How about we buy some cake and fried 
chicken and relax with a movie in the 
trainer's office? When I answered with 
that..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, I used to think so too until 
recently. But ya see...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I just found something pretty interesting.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da-da-daaa~♪ A 'molecular 
gastronomy'... kind of dinner!

The presented smartphone screen showed a 
special page for a restaurant. It appeared 
to be a reservation site for a Christmas 
dinner.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Look at this. Apparently, it's a potage 
made by extracting the umami and oils with 
a centrifuge.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Besides that, there's meat and fish 
espumas, fruit sorbet made with liquid 
nitrogen, as well as vacuum distillation 
and sous-vide cooking—

Curious dishes flashed one after another 
across the screen as Transcend scrolled.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's the near-future 'Innovation 
Gourmet' for you. What do you think?”

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right? Gives you chills, doesn't it? I've 
been curious about this kind of thing for 
a while.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what it tastes like?" 'Course 
for parties of two. Same-day reservations 
OK.' ...*glance*

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainy, you're quick on the 
uptake♪ I'll go get changed, so meet me at 
the school gates in 10 minutes~.

And so, full of excitement, we finished 
making the reservation and headed off to 
the shop together!

—However, once we actually arrived at the 
shop...!

text_block_list.name: Lovers
text_block_list.text:
—Here's looking at you, kid. —My, a 
surprise? Ufufu... ♡

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whew~, it's so moody everywhere you look~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you being considerate of me, 
Trainie? Nah, nah, you don't need to do 
that.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, to everyone else, maybe we look like 
we have a 'special relationship' too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Not really... It's fine with me if I look 
that way, you know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan... I haven't been able to say 
this honestly until now.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, all this time, I've 
always...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Pfft... Uhahaha!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry, got carried away with the 
joke. I mean, you're just way too funny, 
Trainie~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: No, no, I didn't say anything, did I~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I wonder what you were expecting me 
to say, Trai-chan?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Still, that helped take the edge off your 
nerves, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If you're overthinking it, you won't even 
be able to taste the delicious food, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's sit down. I can't wait to 
taste innovation♪

And with that, the course meal was brought 
out. The mix of frustration and 
embarrassment gradually faded as we took 
in the uniquely presented dishes—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, how fancy~. Colorful smoke... and 
they toast it right at your table!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It tastes like turkey, yet it's melty and 
fluffy. What a truly fascinating 
texture...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —Phew, so tasty~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The waiter's explanations are so fun too, 
this is way better than I imagined! Right, 
Trai-chan?♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Post-meal dessert... looks like it'll take 
a bit longer. I'm gonna head to the 
restroom real quick~

Savoring the lingering aftertaste... Yet, 
as I waited absentmindedly, the 
frustration from earlier suddenly came 
flooding back.

That "surprise" the other customers did... 
I should ask if they can set one up for us 
right now. I want to surprise her...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm back~. Oh, did dessert just arrive? 
Man, another one where I can't even 
imagine what it tastes like.
choice_data_list: They said to pour this sauce over it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh, let's see here... Oh, it changes 
color~. Are there words appearing...?

What emerged on the plate was the surprise 
message I had ordered earlier.

text_block_list.name: Message
text_block_list.text:
I'm crazy about you(r racing) —I'm crazy 
about you (and your racing)—

text_block_list.name: Message
text_block_list.text:
I'm crazy about you(r racing) —I am 
infatuated with you (and your racing)—

Giving a deliberate wink and holding back 
a laugh, I watch to see her reaction... 
but.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... And here I was wondering what it 
was.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! So you're totally crazy 
about me, huh~! A-hahahaha!

She responded nonchalantly. It seems she 
has the upper hand here. However...
choice_data_list:
I was joking around, but I really meant 
it.

text_block_list.text:
It may be an exaggeration, but it is true 
that I am utterly captivated by her 
running...

Brushing it off as 'just a joke' didn't 
feel right, so I wanted to make sure I 
conveyed it properly.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know. Just how much you love my 
running, Tra-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, it's true. Do these eyes 
look like they're lying to you?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing you say that makes me really 
happy. Thanks a bunch, Trainie."

A touch of loneliness grazed my heart, 
but... this is just how we are.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"No problem, thank you as well. It's not 
often you find someone willing to go along 
with something so sudden~."
choice_data_list:
Is that so? Even though you have so many 
friends?

Really? Even though you have so many 
friends?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, "a hedge between keeps friendship 
green," huh? Come on, you don't need to be 
so formal with me, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Just meeting up on a whim and hanging 
out casually. Talking endlessly without 
having to think about a thing...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
People like that are surprisingly 
precious, aren't they? Like, you're on the 
same wavelength~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"No, seriously. People like that don't 
just come around very often in a lifetime, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, well... I guess I messed around a bit 
too much myself.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What I said earlier was from the bottom of 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I can feel how much you care, 
Trainer-chan, and it really makes me 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Might not look like it, though. Ahahaha.

She said it nonchalantly, in her usual 
tone. A gentle warmth spread through my 
chest.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see it! Illuminations really are the 
best way to wrap things up, huh~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Recent LEDs sure are bright. Hmm. No 
flickering, and to think they save power 
too."
choice_data_list: That's what you meant? But I get ya.
Oh, that's what you meant. But I get it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you get it? Man, I really wonder 
which manufacturer made it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's go look and see if it's written 
down somewhere!

And so, while enjoying the 
illuminations... or rather, the evolution 
of gadgets—

And so, we spent a Christmas that was both 
special, and yet just like any other.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, can I tell you how I feel once more? 
After all... tonight's a special holy 
night.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You know... to tell the truth, I've 
always, always wanted to tell you, 
Train-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I was just wondering when to give you 
this present~♪"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yay, Merry Christmaaaas☆ Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "...Did I surprise you? Ufufu..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Payback for your payback~ Did you 
really think you could tease Tran-san and 
get away with it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, regardless, the present is real. Go 
ahead and open it.

I opened the box I received. Inside was 
the latest neck speaker.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, I'm glad you're happy with it. The 
quality is fully certified by our place, 
you know~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"For a special, special someone, I wanna 
give something really nice, after all♪"

It was a laid-back relationship full of 
goofing off. Yet, that night made it clear 
that a genuine bond truly existed between 
them.
